prompt_hints: Editorial gallery pacing — the artwork is the interface; type and whitespace stay quiet.
Lead with the work: hero is a single painting, then a showcase wall of available pieces.
Caption pieces like a gallery label (title, medium, dimensions, year) — never product-badge copy.
CTAs are 'View the collection' and 'Inquire about a piece' — never booking, checkout, or dashboards.
Copy speaks as the artist/gallery to collectors and designers, never demo-agency voice.
